About this job
Cyber Defense Research Engineer C5I (f/m/d)
Work experience
80-100%
Every day, around 3,000 employees of RUAG and RUAG Real Estate make as significant contribution to the security of Switzerland. They ensure that the Swiss Armed Forces and other emergency and security organizations can comprehensibly carry out their tasks at all times.
You can move it
Conduct in-depth analysis of advanced malware, firmware and complex software stacks
Dissect embedded hardware and document findings in clear technical reports
Design and develop scalable reverse engineering and analysis frameworks
Take ownership of analysis tasks and contribute to team knowledge-sharing
Contribute to research and innovation initiatives in the cyber defense domain
Collaborate with internal and external partners to strengthen national cyber defense capabilities
Support secure, sovereign and mission-critical systems in a national security context
What you should bring with you
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent practical experience
Hands-on experience in reverse engineering complex software or hardware systems
Experience working with industry-standard reverse engineering tools and debugging techniques
Solid understanding of assembly languages x86/x64, ARM and MIPS and low-level system internals
Hardware and electronics knowledge such as PCB basics and signal debugging is an advantage
Experience building automation, tooling or analysis pipelines such as scripting and frameworks
Strong analytical mindset and ability to communicate complex findings clearly
Excellent English language skills; German is a plus
Swiss citizenship or eligibility for national security clearance
Do you not fully meet all the requirements? Apply anyway. We are always looking for talented and motivated people to join our team. We place great emphasis on diversity and equal opportunities and aim to build a versatile team where everyone can fully utilize their personal strengths. In particular, we encourage all people, regardless of gender, who may have concerns about accepting a position in a military-related environment to apply.
About the field of activity
The C5I Business Area of RUAG supports the Swiss Army in the implementation of ICT projects, with a specific focus on the Cyber Command. In this context, we have the opportunity to contribute to highly secure and sovereign IT systems. Over the past eight years, we have grown from zero to 260 employees (Business Area C5I), offering a unique and dynamic environment with a startup character. This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of the Swiss Army's digital transformation. If you want to contribute to the security policy landscape, you've come to the right place. We work in an agile manner and consistently follow the DevSecOps model. With the C5I-Campus, we have created an innovation space and offer highly attractive workplaces. For technical inquiries, Benoît Perroud, Head of Weisshorn C5I, is happy to assist you: Phone +41 79 711 62 39 | Email benoit.perroud@ruag.ch
No agency applications will be considered for this position.
Your advantages
Your well-being is important to us. That's why we offer you many advantages. These include, for example:
Salary and fringe benefits
We offer you a performance-oriented salary in line with the market, 13 months' wages as well as generous premiums and bonuses. Together with additional fringe benefits this makes for an attractive overall package.
Flexible work
It is very important to us that our employees find a healthy balance between their professional and private lives. This is why, among other things, we offer flexible working hours and options for working from home.
Benefits
At RUAG, you benefit from discounts on transportation and meals. You can also take advantage of attractive offers on our benefits portal and receive fleet discounts from a number of well-known car brands.
Career and development opportunities
We are committed to developing and realizing the potential of our employees. For this reason, we support them in continuously expanding their skills through training, courses and further education so they can achieve their professional goals.
Leisure activities
We care about our employees. That is why we give them a day off for their birthday, offer a wide range of sports activities and the opportunity to take additional days off with a pay deduction in addition to their annual vacation entitlement.
